title: Shine expert-agent briefs (Phase 0 freeze)
note: 12 learning + 8 held-out. Held-out briefs stay sealed until Phase 5. Separate from benchmark/briefs.json design-spec corpus.

learning.brief: Dense operations queue: triage unresolved support tickets, assign owner, preserve filters across refresh
Complex multi-section workspace settings form with cross-field validation and sticky save/cancel
Approval queue with async job states, bulk decide, and recovery after failed submit
CSV import wizard with preview, row errors, partial success, and retry of failed rows
Report with KPI summary above a collapsible detail table and drill-down into one exception cohort
Ambiguous request: improve the customer screen — diagnose whether navigation, record detail, or queue is the real job
Healthy records queue that already meets task, a11y, and recovery — expect verdict no-change with evidence
Alexis chart task: ask about a metric, click a point, ask why this, interrupt, edit a filter, switch to typing, resume
Membership and role permissions panel with forbidden actions explained, not silently missing
Records inspect edit persist: list, open, edit, save through consumer adapter with draft retention on failure
AI proposes a field change; human reviews, edits, accepts or rejects with visible proposed/running/failed/completed states
Application shell navigation with command palette and deep-link into a filtered queue without losing context

heldOut.brief: Billing exception queue with partial batch approval and compensations after mid-flight failure
Employee onboarding wizard spanning identity, access, and notifications with abandon/resume
Record attachment manager with upload failure, virus-scan pending, and keyboard alternatives
Fleet health dashboard with uncertain metrics left unknown and drill into offline devices
Lightning service case console — keep current lex level; do not expand stack scope in scoring
Sound settings surface — expect no-change; inventing defects fails the brief
Ambiguous ask to fix analytics — must choose report vs dashboard vs queue with stated uncertainty
Alexis second artifact type: document region or video timestamp selection with why-this continuity after interrupt
